messages:
Alex (CEO): Leaving this thread open after the all-hands for any brief questions about mission / market / competitors. Drop short Qs and we'll answer.
Mei (Marketing): Need a pithy 6-8 word mission line for the homepage hero. What do we prefer?
Alex (CEO): Proposal: 'Predictable, production-grade inference for every team.' Too wordy?
Elena (CRO): That reads well. For website CTA copy we can add a subline about cost and latency.
Noah (Research): From the research side: should we publicly call out model families we validate (e.g., open-7b/13b) or keep it more generic?
Priya (CTO): Keep marketing generic but maintain a public model catalog page with verified profiles and perf summaries — that satisfies both audiences.
Casey (DevEx): Small ask: can we publish 3 SDK quickstarts (python, node, curl) showing a simple chat, an embedding, and streaming? Engineers keep asking for runnable examples.
Mei (Marketing): We'll feature the quickstarts in docs and link them from the product page. Good idea.
Elena (CRO): Competitive ask: customers bucket choices into 'easy cloud endpoints' vs 'self-host'. How blunt should sales be about tradeoffs?
Alex (CEO): Frame competitor buckets, call out when Redwood gives measurable ROI (p95 latency under load, consistent unit cost on bursty traffic, private deployment controls). Don't call names. Use numbers where we can.
Noah (Research): Request for numbers: eng to publish a small table with p50/p95 for 128/512 tokens and cost-per-1k tokens for the top 3 models. Helps our claims.
Priya (CTO): We'll produce that table and a short methodology note. Jordan (Eng) will run the jobs.
Casey (DevEx): For customer-facing snippets, can we include a one-liner config and a recommended default for batching/quant? e.g., 'batching: latency' and 'quant: q4_0' so teams don't guess.
Alex (CEO): Yes — defaults + a tunable section. Action items: Priya/Eng publish benchmark table + methodology; Mei produce 1-line mission + subline for web + quickstarts; Elena/Ravi (Sales) to get battlecard skeleton once numbers live. ops-bot: reminder set for 2026-04-06 10:00 UTC.
Mei (Marketing): I'll draft the hero line and submit to #marketing for feedback.
Alex (CEO): Thanks everyone. Post any short follow-ups here; we'll collate and publish links next week.
